changelog: SaralGati 6.1.0 (Zero-Escape Fraud Scan & Threat-Biased Prioritization): Removed premature JNI traversal cutoff from traverseNode so 100% of visible screen nodes are scanned by OfflineFraudSentinel with zero chance of missing scams in long/bloated views, and added Threat-Biased Prioritization (ranking OTP, PIN, UPI, KYC, APK, remote access keywords first) when capping elements for the backend API.
